description: List, create, update, or delete this workspace's FAQ items (shown in the chat widget and usable by the AI agent). Set `action` to 'list' | 'create' | 'update' | 'delete'. 'create' needs `question` + `answer`; 'update' and 'delete' need `id`.

answer.description: Answer text. Required for 'create'; optional for 'update'.

enabled.description: Whether the FAQ item is visible/active. Optional for 'create' and 'update'.

id.description: FAQ item id. Required for 'update' and 'delete'.

question.description: Question text. Required for 'create'; optional for 'update'.

name: manage_faq
title: Manage FAQ
